title: SMA: Who Said That? Auditing Membership Leakage in Semi-Black-box RAG Controlling
abstract: arXiv:2508.09105v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and its Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) significantly improve the knowledge coverage and contextual understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) by introducing external knowledge sources. However, retrieval and multimodal fusion obscure content provenance, rendering existing membership inference methods unable to reliably attribute generated outputs to pre-training, external retrieval, or user input, thus undermining privacy leakage accountability   To address these challenges, we propose the first Source-aware Membership Audit (SMA) that enables fine-grained source attribution of generated content in a semi-black-box setting with retrieval control capabilities. To address the environmental constraints of semi-black-box auditing, we further design an attribution estimation mechanism based on zero-order optimization, which robustly approximates the true influence of input tokens o

translated_title: SMA：谁说的？在半黑盒RAG控制中审计成员泄露
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）及其多模态检索增强生成（MRAG）通过引入外部知识源，显著提升了大型语言模型（LLMs）的知识覆盖范围和上下文理解能力。然而，检索和多模态融合模糊了内容来源，使得现有的成员推断方法无法可靠地将生成输出归因于预训练、外部检索或用户输入，从而削弱了隐私泄露的可问责性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了首个来源感知成员审计（SMA），它能够在具有检索控制能力的半黑盒设置中，对生成内容进行细粒度的来源归因。针对半黑盒审计的环境约束，我们进一步设计了一种基于零阶优化的归因估计机制，该机制能够稳健地近似输入令牌的真实影响。
tldr: 本文提出了首个来源感知成员审计方法（SMA），在半黑盒检索控制环境中实现生成内容的细粒度来源归因，以解决RAG系统隐私泄露的问责难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the first Source-aware Membership Audit (SMA) for fine-grained source attribution of generated content in semi-black-box RAG settings, addressing privacy leakage accountability challenges.
